question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you participate in races?
options: Yeah! I'm always on the move!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Can you reach it?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Almost there, and... I got it!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: See you in the winner's circle!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! I totally won! How many points did I win for Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That would be `none`, actually.
nodes.text_bbcode: That would be [color=#3b78e2][i]none[/i][/color], actually.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?! I was in front the whole way! How did you get here ahead of me?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Son, did the sickly orphans ask `how` Obadiah brought them their medicine? No! They were simply grateful to be alive!
nodes.text_bbcode: Son, did the sickly orphans ask [color=#e23b3b][i]how[/i][/color] Obadiah brought them their medicine? No! They were simply grateful to be alive!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I do hereby award Centerscore High School `ten points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I do hereby award Centerscore High School [color=#e23b3b][i]ten points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes! We just put ourselves ten points closer to victory!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Having won the first event, the Centerscore team was emboldened.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But little did they know... Things were about to get much more difficult.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ouch! Phil, you dropped me!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Forget it. Just help me get up.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Okay... So should we try again?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And risk another faceplant? I think not. Let's just go the long way.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A few minutes later, Kim and Phil lurched across the finish line.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... How did we do, Judge Tigh?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Third place, I'm afraid. And for that, Centerscore high receives `zero` points.
nodes.text_bbcode: Third place, I'm afraid. And for that, Centerscore high receives [color=#e23b3b][i]zero[/i][/color] points.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Heh! Looks like those Centerscore losers forgot to bring their A-game.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: A-game? I'm not sure they even brought their Z-game.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Mallika, are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm trying to restrain myself. I feel a sudden urge to drop-kick Tom Prince into the Pacific... Again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Just forget him, Mallika. We need to concentrate on making up time in the next event.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Having lost the first event, the Centerscore team grew dispirited.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But little did they know... Things were about to get much, much worse.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, now you should also come up with a cool call sign like 'Road Hawk', or 'Eagle One', or 'Ostrich Pompadour'.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Basically, you just pick a bird and then add the first word that comes to mind.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay. I'll try it. Kim, Phil... This is `Cuddly Owl.` Are you in position? Over.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay. I'll try it. Kim, Phil... This is [color=#3b78e2][i]Cuddly Owl.[/i][/color] Are you in position? Over.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, Mallika. We're here, but I'm not exactly sure why `I'm` the one running this race.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Mallika. We're here, but I'm not exactly sure why [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one running this race.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: These kids from Spartan and Wilson look really fast.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Speed isn't everything, Kim. The opening route makes several sharp turns.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You might not be faster than the other contestants, but you should be able to pick up some time by jumping over the fence.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Forget pace... This race is all about `parkour.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget pace... This race is all about [color=#3b78e2][i]parkour.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Cool. 'Running with style' is something I can definitely do.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Okay, but what about me?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: There's a steep wall early on. We'll need you to give Kim a boost over it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Contestants, on your marks... Get set... Go!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, the Crosstown Races began!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Almost immediately, Spartan Academy pulled into the lead!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Eat my dust!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil! Chad and Skazz are getting away!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Not to worry. This is the wall Mallika was talking about. If I can lift you over, you'll be able to cut across the vacant lot.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... It is?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean, think about it. We spent hours getting the Mobile Command Center operational, but we never worked out an orderly system of communication.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And if we want to be serious competitors, we need to act serious. And that means military discipline.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cool... I think?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now, to try out our new system. Kim, this is Mallika. Do you copy? Over.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Copy that. Over.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You hear that? It worked!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mallika, I'm being serious. I really think...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know what you think, but we're all friends here, Hector. We respect each other. That means we can communicate effectively without having to resort to some artificially-imposed system.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now then, to prove my point... Kim? Kim...?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Are you going to answer that?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I would, but every time I try to respond she says something else!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, for the love of... Gimme that! Kim, this is Mobile Command. `Over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, for the love of... Gimme that! Kim, this is Mobile Command. [color=#e23b3b][i]Over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Reading you loud and clear, Hector. `Over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Reading you loud and clear, Hector. [color=#3b78e2][i]Over.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow, Hector. I guess you were right about that.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: These torches symbolize hope! Carry them bravely! Carry them honorably!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the Judge continued his oration, Tom Prince turned and whispered quietly to Howard and Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh. I'm impressed. Looks like you two losers managed to organize enough of your dimwit friends to make this race interesting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad you think losing is interesting. You'll be doing a lot of it.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You really think you could beat us, Tom? `All Wilson knows how to do is win!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You really think you could beat us, Tom? [color=#e23b3b][i]All Wilson knows how to do is win![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: AHEM!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry. I had a... Frog in my throat.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Captains, send your representatives to the starting line. The race is about to begin!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mallika, did the radio mics in the `Mobile Command Center` pick that up?
nodes.text_bbcode: Mallika, did the radio mics in the [color=#e23b3b][i]Mobile Command Center[/i][/color] pick that up?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We sure did! Angie, dispatch Kim and Phil to the starting line.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: On it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hector, take us to Checkpoint Alpha.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: En route.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll uplink communications protocols into our dedicated V.O.X. SkyFire satellite.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess I got carried away. I'll be operating this radio transceiver we borrowed from the school's A.V. club.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now then... Kim, Phil, are you two in position?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mallika, I think you have to say 'over' when you're done broadcasting. It's standard radio protocol.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Really? That's...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the assembly concluded, Howard, Alexei, and Tom, the three representatives of each school gathered at the starting line.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Team Captains, please step forward and light your torches.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who cares about pomp and circumstance?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: These next few hours will determine whether we win or lose. We need to make sure everything goes perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly what I was thinking!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Okay, but what happens if we miss something important?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever. What could we possibly miss?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, the guys used the final few minutes before the Crosstown Races began to cover the essentials.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, guys, one last time... The Crosstown Races will take us from one side of Centerscore to the other.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Along the way, our team will compete in challenges designed to test our physical strength, our intelligence, and our cunning.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: By winning events, our team will accumulate points. At the end of the race, the school with the most points wins! Everybody got it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan, you look a little unsure...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, I get that... I just hope we didn't miss anything important at the assembly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean... We're participating in the Crosstown Races, aren't we? As long as we're here, we should find out what the event is all about.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Howard, Brendan, and the rest of the Centerscore students filed into the Auditorium and took their seats.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A few moments later, Judge Tigh stepped out onto the stage.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Ladies, gentlemen, students... As we do each year, we will begin the Crosstown Races by telling the story of the historical events that inspired it.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: It all began one hundred and forty-four years ago, in `1866`, when our town was no bigger than a cluster of cabins.
nodes.text_bbcode: It all began one hundred and forty-four years ago, in [color=#e23b3b][i]1866[/i][/color], when our town was no bigger than a cluster of cabins.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That winter, there came a terrible blizzard... And with the snow came a terrible `sickness...`
nodes.text_bbcode: That winter, there came a terrible blizzard... And with the snow came a terrible [color=#e23b3b][i]sickness...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Many in the town were stricken, most especially the children. Soon, the `schoolhouse` overflowed with the ill.
nodes.text_bbcode: Many in the town were stricken, most especially the children. Soon, the [color=#e23b3b][i]schoolhouse[/i][/color] overflowed with the ill.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: The situation was dire. If `medicine` was not brought, and soon, our town and its people would've perished.
nodes.text_bbcode: The situation was dire. If [color=#e23b3b][i]medicine[/i][/color] was not brought, and soon, our town and its people would've perished.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But medicine was on its way, carried by none other than heroic town `sheriff`, Obadiah Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: But medicine was on its way, carried by none other than heroic town [color=#e23b3b][i]sheriff[/i][/color], Obadiah Prince.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Today, in celebration of that historic trek, the students of our town will retrace the steps of Obadiah...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Carrying a ceremonial `torch` from one edge of Centerscore to the other...
nodes.text_bbcode: Carrying a ceremonial [color=#e23b3b][i]torch[/i][/color] from one edge of Centerscore to the other...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Along the way, these students will compete in a series of events designed to test their physical strength, their intelligence, and their cunning.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Schools that win events will accrue points. At the end, the school with the most accumulated points wins!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The Centerscore High students listened with rapt attention.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Huh, that was actually really informative.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, who knows? That information might even come in handy some day.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor, Paula, and Amanda raced quickly through the mall, leaving the Spartan and Wilson teams to play catch up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! Look at those grubby little fashion victims running through the food court!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If they spent half as much time upgrading their wardrobes as they do upgrading their computers...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They'd know the fastest way to the far side of the mall is through `Lacy's` department store!
nodes.text_bbcode: They'd know the fastest way to the far side of the mall is through [color=#3b78e2][i]Lacy's[/i][/color] department store!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Our short cut should buy us a few seconds on the competition.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Or maybe not.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor! Look!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that... Tom Prince?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor turned and spied Tom Prince and his team riding up the escalator to the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Looks like you three cheerleaders are getting left behind.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! How'd you `Sky Store` simpletons get up there so fast?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! How'd you [color=#3b78e2][i]Sky Store[/i][/color] simpletons get up there so fast?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See you later, cuties!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Cheer-licious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cheer-licious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls... Really?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls... Really?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls... Really?!
Which is `NOT` a two-legged cheerleading stunt?

menu.title: Which is `NOT` a two-legged cheerleading stunt?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go, Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Seriously?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Seriously?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Seriously?!
Which `IS` a real cheerleading throw?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now you're getting it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... What?!
Which is `NOT` a cheerleading position?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Paula is right. The stairs might be slower, but we can't risk performing such an audacious maneuver, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Several minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: You girls made it across the finish line. But for placing third, I must award you with `zero points.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You girls made it across the finish line. But for placing third, I must award you with [color=#e23b3b][i]zero points.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ouch! Those were points we really didn't have to spare.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess we'll have to make it up on the next event.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda is right. We're not here to play it safe. We're here to win! Girls, into Giza formation! Go!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The three Centerscore cheerleaders formed a human pyramid and successfully vaulted onto the second floor landing...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Dropping down just ahead of Tom Prince and his fellow Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wh... What...?! How...?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me spell it out for you, Tom! T. A. L. E. N. T.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What does that spell?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Toenails!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's not what that spells, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know... But I painted mine earlier, and now they're really pretty! See? Sparkly!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Yes... Ahem... Well...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: The winner of the `Mall Dash` is Centerscore High School!
nodes.text_bbcode: The winner of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Mall Dash[/i][/color] is Centerscore High School!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And in recognition of their incredible gymnastic ability, I do hereby award Centerscore High Score with `twenty-five points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And in recognition of their incredible gymnastic ability, I do hereby award Centerscore High Score with [color=#e23b3b][i]twenty-five points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Good work, girls! Every last point counts!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What's the next event?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor, Paula, and Amanda raced through the mall, holding onto second place, until...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Keep going! We're gaining ground, girls! Girls...?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, what are you doing?! This is no time for shopping!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I just saw a pretty, sequiny belt with a heart-shaped belt buckle! And it goes with the silver sandals I saw two stores down. And...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, snap out of it!!!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wha... What happened?!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You were mesmerized by shiny, metallic objects again!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And worse, you're letting Tom Prince get away! Look!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Amanda spied Tom Prince and his team riding up the escalator to the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Looks like you three cheerleaders are getting left behind.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How'd you `Sky Store` simpletons get up there so fast?
nodes.text_bbcode: How'd you [color=#3b78e2][i]Sky Store[/i][/color] simpletons get up there so fast?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See you later, cuties!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Taylor, are you, Paula, and Amanda in position?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Mallika, are you seriously asking if the cheerleaders are `at the mall?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Mallika, are you seriously asking if the cheerleaders are [color=#3b78e2][i]at the mall?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, now that you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Relax! We're all here!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And `Nordbottom's` just had their twice yearly shoe event!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]Nordbottom's[/i][/color] just had their twice yearly shoe event!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was utter shoe-phoria!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, did you just... Make a clever pun?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe...?! Or maybe I read that sign over there out loud instead of speaking my own brain-words.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It happens sometimes when I `summer fashion event!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It happens sometimes when I [color=#3b78e2][i]summer fashion event![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Anyway. Taylor, could you get your squad to the starting line?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure. Where was that again?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr! We went over this three times!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Didn't I tell you to relax? Nobody knows this mall better than `us.` Right, girls?
nodes.text_bbcode: Didn't I tell you to relax? Nobody knows this mall better than [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color] Right, girls?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Instead of agreeing, I'm going to ask a question. Why am I not in charge?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because you're mean! You wanted to make me wear a red letter 'B' to punish me for `cheating!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you're mean! You wanted to make me wear a red letter 'B' to punish me for [color=#3b78e2][i]cheating![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: 'Cheating' doesn't start with a 'B', Amanda. You were being punished for 'backstabbing'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe you're right... But I really like Hector, and I'm done listening to a meanie like you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... Girls, give it a rest and come on!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Taylor, Paula, and Amanda stepped up to the starting line.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: One hundred and thirty years ago, upon this spit of land were numerous deadly tar pits.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The more things change, huh...?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Uh... Excuse me, miss?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean... This place still totally sucks you in... Only now it gets you with irresistable deals!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Oh, okay... Heh... That's an amusing notion, young girl. But anyway, back to the story.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Obadiah traversed this treacherous terrain on his way to the schoolhouse. Today, you will too! On your mark... Get set... Race!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go, girls! Work those `Ginny Chews!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's go, girls! Work those [color=#3b78e2][i]Ginny Chews![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And then it was time for the next major event, the infamous `Mall Dash.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And then it was time for the next major event, the infamous [color=#e23b3b][i]Mall Dash.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That judge really has seen it all. I busted the same Inverted Air Slug I used to win the FLEX-Games, and he barely even blinked.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, well... I'm sorry you didn't win, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Didn't win?! More like 'didn't let me finish'.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Because that move didn't impress Judge Tigh, I had to bust out my `Ten-Eighty Re-Inverted Badger Grind.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because that move didn't impress Judge Tigh, I had to bust out my [color=#e23b3b][i]Ten-Eighty Re-Inverted Badger Grind.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It was too cool, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Indeed, I must concur.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Young Spike here brought tears to my eyes with his stirring recreation of authentic pioneer plankboarding techniques!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Plankboarding?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Who cares what it's called? Whatever you did, you just earned us an additional `twenty points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who cares what it's called? Whatever you did, you just earned us an additional [color=#3b78e2][i]twenty points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then in the Old Apple Orchard...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In the middle of his long journey, Obadiah discovered his rations were nearing depletion. He was forced to pick apples from the trees in this orchard in order to survive.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I will now count how many apples each team has collected, starting with Wilson High. I do hereby tally...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Skazz, there are only apple `cores` in this basket. What happened?
nodes.text_bbcode: Skazz, there are only apple [color=#e23b3b][i]cores[/i][/color] in this basket. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I got hungry.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You ate all the apples?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: BUUUUURP!!!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: For both failing the task and producing a nauseatingly stinky belch...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I hereby award Wilson High with `negative fifteen points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I hereby award Wilson High with [color=#e23b3b][i]negative fifteen points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha! That's a 'sour' outcome for you guys.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Looks like Wilson High just caught a nasty break.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah... That's what they get for putting Skazz in charge of food.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Then at the local Business School...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: As you know, living on the frontier was a daily challenge. Most settlers survived by selling the crops and pelts they collected at Trading Posts.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: This `business exam` will test your ability to make a favorable monetary transac...
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#e23b3b][i]business exam[/i][/color] will test your ability to make a favorable monetary transac...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Done!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, Tom Prince... I see you possess your family's keen business acumen. For a perfect score, I hereby award Spartan Academy with `sixty points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, Tom Prince... I see you possess your family's keen business acumen. For a perfect score, I hereby award Spartan Academy with [color=#e23b3b][i]sixty points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What...?! Sixty points?! That's way too many!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: With the end of the Quiz Bowl, the Crosstown Races entered its middle stretch, pitting the three schools against each other in a variety of unusual challenges.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: First, in the Skate Park...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the Quiz bowl continued, Judge Tigh served up tough questions...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But Spud and his crew of unpopular high school intellectuals volleyed back `correct answers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But Spud and his crew of unpopular high school intellectuals volleyed back [color=#e23b3b][i]correct answers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Until, at last...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Whoo boy! You kids really know your town history! I'm impressed.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I hereby award you `fifteen points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I hereby award you [color=#e23b3b][i]fifteen points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes! Fifteen points! We totally rule!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You hear that, Angie? Fifteen points!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Awesome job, guys!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Judge Tigh served up tough questions, catching Spud and his crew of unpopular high school intellectuals totally off guard!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Until, at last...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Stop! We give up! We don't know anything about this stupid town or its stupid history!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Yeah, and if we ever wanted to, we'd just look it up on Wakkapedia.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: They say that kids today have no sense of history!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And I must say... It shows!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: You failed to answer my questions correctly. As such, I'm afraid I must award you `zero points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You failed to answer my questions correctly. As such, I'm afraid I must award you [color=#e23b3b][i]zero points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's okay, guys. I'm sure you did your best. We'll just have to find a way to make it up next time.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, so... What's next on the schedule?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: There is a cheat sheet... And it is called my `powerful brain!`
nodes.text_bbcode: There is a cheat sheet... And it is called my [color=#e23b3b][i]powerful brain![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What?! No...?! But I was so sure!

nodes.text: What?! No...?! But I was so sure!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: We got it right! I knew we could do it!

nodes.text: Spuddykins... Be smarter NOW!!!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Oh yeah! That's right! Take it to pocket protector level for a nerd high five!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Who has two thumbs and memorizes inane trivia at the expense of a healthy social life? This guy!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Why... Can't... I... Remember?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Why... Can't... I... Remember?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Why... Can't... I... Remember?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Uh oh... Maybe Howard should've had us stick around for that speech after all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In a parking lot to the side of the town square, sinister events were afoot...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Steph, where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Back off, Tom. We're done.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hardly! You agreed to help Spartan Academy win the Crosstown Races. We're not done until I'm holding that trophy.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Steph, ask yourself... Do you want that internship at Prince Research Labs or not?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Fine... What were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, the two conspirators hatched a devious plot...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Meanwhile, the Crosstown Races continued...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, guys, the next major event is the 'Quiz Bowl'. In this event, our team will be asked a series of questions.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Just so you know... Wilson High already failed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Spartan had that creepy nerd Preston on their side... And they aced it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are we in position, Angie?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Copy that, Mallika. We've got Spud, Kat, and Dexter on deck.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spud, this is Cuddly Owl. Are you ready? Over.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Heh... Does your evil doppelganger have a goatee?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Was that a 'yes' or...?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! We're obviously ready!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, but I still don't see what facial hair has to do with it.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Just forget it! Judge Tigh is here. That means this event is about to start!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Okay, kids. I'm going to test how well you were paying attention during the speech I gave this morning.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha! Good sailing, Dinah! By tacking into the wind, you've managed to bring us about in front of both Spartan and Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This isn't over yet! The Spartan vessel is readying its catapults!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Not a problem... Cranking up the RPM's on our onboard motor will get us out of range.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Heh... 'Let them eat wake!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look! We did it! We were the first team to get our torch to the far shore!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, but it looks like Wilson High wasn't so lucky.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: The fireball melted our plastic pontoons. Our... Our boat was scuttled.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Good work, guys! According to the Judge, you earned ten points for winning and another twenty points for winning in style!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But don't start celebrating just yet... There are still three more events to go.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Obadiah Prince, hear me! You seek a fortune, and you shall find one... Though it will not be the fortune you seek.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: First, you must travel a long and difficult road, a road fraught with perils. There will be orphans who need medicine and also a lizard.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oracle, did you say... A `lizard?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oracle, did you say... A [color=#e23b3b][i]lizard?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Verily! I speak of the fabled iguana of Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Sniff... I'm not sure I've ever seen a more riveting performance of the play `'Obadiah, Where Art Thou?'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sniff... I'm not sure I've ever seen a more riveting performance of the play [color=#e23b3b][i]'Obadiah, Where Art Thou?'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sniff... I thought that was beautiful. Angie, what did you think?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I think... Sniff... Judge Tigh just gave us `thirty-five points.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think... Sniff... Judge Tigh just gave us [color=#3b78e2][i]thirty-five points.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And then on the track...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: It came to pass that Obadiah reached a hillock he could not climb.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Using a rod fashioned from the trunk of a sapling elm, Obadiah propelled himself gracefully over the obstruction.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: To commemorate that remarkable leap, you students each performed a 'high jump'. And though you all leaped well... Spartan High leapt best.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Check it! Who says rich men can't jump?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Nobody says that, Chad. It isn't a thing.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: For their bravery, I hereby award Spartan High with `seventy-five points.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For their bravery, I hereby award Spartan High with [color=#e23b3b][i]seventy-five points.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And finally, after a long day of activity... There was just one event left!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: GROOOOOOOWWWLL!!!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ouch... That's going to cost us!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And then...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Andy, are absolutely sure you want to go through with this?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Mallika, I may have lost my one good eye to an accident involving a crossbow, a Granny Smythe apple, and the William tell Overture...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Huh? I thought Andy lost his eye running from angry cows in Pamplona.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But the one thing I `refuse` to lose is my sense of gamesmanship. If I quit now, where would the team be?
nodes.text_bbcode: But the one thing I [color=#e23b3b][i]refuse[/i][/color] to lose is my sense of gamesmanship. If I quit now, where would the team be?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hector, didn't you dress up as cupid for Valentine's Day one year? If I recall, you were a pretty good shot with a bow...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, so good I got suspended for a week! How was I supposed to know Cupid didn't use `real` arrows?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, so good I got suspended for a week! How was I supposed to know Cupid didn't use [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] arrows?!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Enough! Judge, hand me my bow!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andy took the bow, drew back the string, and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Whoa! Mallika, did you see that?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Andy just hit a bull's-eye!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And I hereby award you with... `Fifteen points!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I hereby award you with... [color=#e23b3b][i]Fifteen points![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yup... And let that be a lesson to you all. Depth perception isn't everything.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Just wait a second, your Honor! When did Obadiah Prince ever wrestle a `grizzly bear?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just wait a second, your Honor! When did Obadiah Prince ever wrestle a [color=#e23b3b][i]grizzly bear?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, I'm not sure exactly... But he must've done it, otherwise why would there be a 'bear wrestling' event?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You're asking me?!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Quit stalling, kid! Get in there and show us what you're made of!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The next events passed quickly. First, in the theater...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you doing, Dinah? They're coming right at you! Turn! Turn!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The Spartan Academy vessel plowed into the starboard hull of 'Rudder Destruction'.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The Centerscore vessel listed to the side and...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Ksssttt!!!` The torch glanced across the surface of the water. Steam rose up, but the torch did not go out.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ksssttt!!![/i][/color] The torch glanced across the surface of the water. Steam rose up, but the torch did not go out.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Several minutes later, Brendan, Dinah, and Megan hauled their soggy vessel up the sandy lakeshore.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If Spartan Academy hadn't cheated, we totally could've won that event!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Now, kids. Did Obadiah Prince complain that anybody `cheated` during his historic ride across Centerscore?
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, kids. Did Obadiah Prince complain that anybody [color=#e23b3b][i]cheated[/i][/color] during his historic ride across Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: No, of course, he didn't! For finishing third, I award you `zero points.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course, he didn't! For finishing third, I award you [color=#e23b3b][i]zero points.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And for giving me lip, I subtract `thirty points.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And for giving me lip, I subtract [color=#e23b3b][i]thirty points.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Negative thirty points?! You old coot! I'll show you!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Guys! It's bad enough you lost the event, but did you really have to antagonize the judge, too?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: They're just upset. They worked really hard on that boat.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're right, Angie... And besides, there are three more events left.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But I warn you to be careful! If the torch goes out, you'll be penalized `sixty points` for your error!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I warn you to be careful! If the torch goes out, you'll be penalized [color=#e23b3b][i]sixty points[/i][/color] for your error!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Adventurers, hear me! Ready your craft... Set your course... Go!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And Obadiah, as handsome as he was intrepid...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, right!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Excuse me, young lady?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't keep listening to this. Obadiah Prince was a thief and an outlaw! From everything I've read, I can promise you he never would've helped anyone intentionally.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah! You shouldn't be...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: No, son. The girl is right.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I am?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: As a judge, I am well aware that there are two sides to every story. And Obadiah Prince did indeed have a checkered past.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But traditions are about more than facts. They are about belief. And it is our shared belief in Obadiah's epic heroism that brings us together today.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Whether or not these heroic events are 'real' is, at best, a secondary concern.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... I guess that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Now, if you don't mind, I'd like to continue... In recreating Obadiah's adventure, you will pilot your radio-controlled boats to the far bank.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Dinah did her best to keep her emotions bottled up inside, but as the speech continued...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Obadiah reached the center of the river. There, the current threatened to sweep him away. But he persevered...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Must... Keep... It... Bottled... Up...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Riding ever onward for the sake of the children... The precious, sickly children that were counting on him!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Must... Not...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And who but a hero of Obadiah Princes's magnitude could possibly hope to...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: AAAAACCCKKKK!!!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Miss, are you all right? Do you need medical attention?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I just... Could we maybe just skip the speech?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: What?! I spent hours preparing this document!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hmph! Fine! I suppose you've already ruined my train of thought. I'll just skip ahead to the last paragraph.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But you should know, you and your team are on my radar screen now, missy! And there better not be any more shenanigans!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Now then... In recreating Obadiah's adventure, you will pilot your radio-controlled boats to the far bank.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Brendan, Dinah, Megan... How are you doing? Over.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We've affixed the torch to the mast of our radio-controlled vessel, 'Rudder Destruction', and we're ready to send our boat on its maiden voyage.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And the other teams?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wilson High is piloting a mini-catamaran, and Spartan Academy has entered a Grecian trireme.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Trireme?! That doesn't sound so bad.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe not usually, but this one... It shoots fireballs!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know it's tough, but you guys are going to have to do the best you can. Now get to the starting line. This heat is about to start.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A few moments later...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: During his historic journey across our town, Obadiah Prince forded Lake Centerscore atop his trusted steed.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, what's going on? Why are you fidgeting?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's just... We investigated Obadiah Prince for the school paper. We know that this entire event is based on a lie.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: He wasn't a noble sheriff! He was a murderous outlaw!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure, I know that... But is now the best time to bring it up?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe, maybe not, Brendan. I think I should...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But unfortunately, the next event will have to wait.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because, right at that very moment, trouble was brewing near the Centerscore High ready station.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Linda, is that you? We need to get down to the football field to prepare for the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... Why won't the lights turn on?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! You're not Linda! What're you doing in here?! What are you...?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Howard tumbled backward as Steph shoved past him.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hearing Howard's cries, Linda... The `real` Linda... And Kenji jogged over.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hearing Howard's cries, Linda... The [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] Linda... And Kenji jogged over.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, what happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was Steph... I think she was tampering with our equipment.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa... You weren't kidding! It looks like Steph snipped some of the stitches on the bindings you and Linda were going to use for the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What? Why would she do that?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So the bindings would `break` mid-race. Getting separated from your partner in a three-legged race is grounds for instant disqualification.
nodes.text_bbcode: So the bindings would [color=#e23b3b][i]break[/i][/color] mid-race. Getting separated from your partner in a three-legged race is grounds for instant disqualification.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then it's a good thing you stopped her, Howard. Otherwise, we would've lost everything. But now we can fix the bindings and be ready to compete!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Well, I wouldn't be too optimistic about our chances. When I fell over, I think I twisted my ankle.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Your ankle? But that means...!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know! I won't be able to race!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: So you see, Steph may not have carried out her plan, but she did deliver Centerscore a mighty setback.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: We'll hear more about Howard, Kenji, and Linda in a bit, but right now I should tell you what happened along the banks of Lake Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Kenji and Linda stumbled and fell!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ow! Kenji, what were you doing?! You nearly took my knee off!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No way... We were in sync! It must've been something else.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Look, this is a trip-line! And over there... Howard is holding it!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, I knew you didn't like the idea of me racing with Kenji, but `this...` You betrayed all of Centerscore High just to act out a grudge?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard, I knew you didn't like the idea of me racing with Kenji, but [color=#3b78e2][i]this...[/i][/color] You betrayed all of Centerscore High just to act out a grudge?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Linda, listen to me! It isn't like that! It was Steph! She set up the trip-line! I was trying to stop her!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes! And then she must've slipped away in all the commotion.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And the winner is... `Spartan Academy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the winner is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan Academy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! We totally rule!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're unbelievable, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Seriously, dude. Just don't even bother.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Kenji and Linda bolted from the starting line... Immediately leaving Tom Prince and his partner in the dust.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow! Kenji, you weren't kidding!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We really are in `sync!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We really are in [color=#3b78e2][i]sync![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Told you!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Tom, we're losing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not to worry. All I have to do is signal Steph!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Tom Prince gestured to the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Okay, Tom. Looks like that's my cue!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But as Steph readied the trip line... Howard leapt toward her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not on my watch!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: No! Hey! Leggo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! You let go!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Great... But not quite perfect. Why not play again and try to unlock the special bonus scene?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Just as his ancestor, Obadiah, had done almost a hundred and sixty years ago, Tom Prince made a legendary trek across Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It was a triumph for the ages, a heroic feat that would be spoken of by storytellers for ages to come...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And our gang of heroes, how did they endure the gross indignity of this historic defeat?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not well.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For the rest of their lives, the students of Centerscore High would look back on this race, and they would wonder... `'What if'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: For the rest of their lives, the students of Centerscore High would look back on this race, and they would wonder... [color=#e23b3b][i]'What if'?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Yikes! Well, that was a terrible ending... Unless, of course, you were `rooting` for that dirty cheater Tom Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yikes! Well, that was a terrible ending... Unless, of course, you were [b]rooting[/b] for that dirty cheater Tom Prince.

nodes.text: But... You weren't, were you?
Well, in that case, you need to take responsibility for your mistakes and play again from the very beginning.
And next time, do your best to help Centerscore High bring home the win!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And that, my friends, is the story of how Centerscore High School won the Crosstown Races!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And as you now know, it was one of the truly epic stories in the history of this school!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And what's more, you were with these students every step of the way, striving just as they strived, persevering as they persevered...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: They ran a great race, but you... You played a `great game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They ran a great race, but you... You played a [color=#e23b3b][i]great game![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! We win! We win! Eat it, suckers!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Kenji and Linda bolted from the starting line... And promptly fell face-forward into a pitiable heap.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ow! Kenji, what were you doing?! You nearly took my kneecap off!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know... I thought we were in sync.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And the winner is... Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! We totally rule!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And where was Howard during all this commotion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not letting you cheat!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Like it even matters! Your dumb friends barely got two feet before tripping all over themselves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! Really?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: And that is my cue to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Going into the final event, Centerscore and Spartan are neck and neck... Jockeying for `first place.`

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And Wilson High is out of the running.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoever wins the three-legged race is going to `win it all.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoever wins the three-legged race is going to [color=#3b78e2][i]win it all.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! No!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We can't let Spartan Academy win!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look on the bright side... If we're not running, it doesn't matter that you hurt your ankle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa... I just realized something!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now that we've been sidelined, we'll have to root for... Wilson?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And root they did...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's go Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Go Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Rainbows and ponies!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ech... I don't know about you guys, but just saying that makes me feel dirty.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But it was to no avail!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Tom Prince and his fellow Spartans raced across the finish line ahead of Alexei and Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey everyone, the judges have just tallied up the points.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Unfortunately, we've fallen so far behind that there's no point in competing in the final event.

nodes.text: Okay, now let's get started.

nodes.text: Not that Howard and Linda should, like, feel any pressure or anything.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hector! Why would you say that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nevermind. Howard, this is Cuddly Owl. Are you and Linda in position? Over.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh... Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kenji, is that you? What happened to Howard?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mallika, there was an accident earlier, and we were forced to make a substitution.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Actually, I like to think of it as trading up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, but I hope you guys know what you're doing.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And where was Howard during all of this?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He had limped over to the bleachers to rest his wounded ankle, when...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! That's Tom Prince! And it looks like he's up to something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I better stay low and out of sight.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What do we do now, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: We were so busy framing those Centerscore kids for arson that we never got around to practicing for the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Relax, Preston, start breathing already.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So we didn't practice? All that does is put us on even footing with the 'substitute' Centerscore High team.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And besides, you've forgotten about our `secret weapon.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And besides, you've forgotten about our [color=#e23b3b][i]secret weapon.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Uh... Which is...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We `cheat`, idiot!
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]cheat[/i][/color], idiot!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If the Centerscore kids get ahead of us, Steph is going to deploy an invisible tripwire across the track.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Heh... That's pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Contestants, please take your positions for our final event of the day, the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Forewarned of the treachery, Howard began a frantic search for Steph.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She has to be around here somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But Howard could not be in two places at once. At the starting line, Linda scanned the bleachers for her boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know Howard was upset that he couldn't participate in the race with me... But why isn't he here to cheer me on?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Truth is... Some guys are just like that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess you're right, Kenji... This isn't the first time Howard hasn't been there for me when I needed him.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Contestants, please strap yourselves together and stumble awkwardly forward.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Meanwhile, Howard limped through the crowd, looking left, looking right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on... Come on...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And at the starting line...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: In the final stretch of his inspirational journey across Centerscore, Obadiah approached the schoolhouse.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Although he was weak and wounded, Obadiah would not relent.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Heartened by his bravery, the `School Marm` crossed out into the bracing snow and put her shoulder beneath Obadiah's arm.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heartened by his bravery, the [color=#e23b3b][i]School Marm[/i][/color] crossed out into the bracing snow and put her shoulder beneath Obadiah's arm.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Together, only three good legs between them... They completed the journey, delivering precious medicine to the gravely ill.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: To symbolize the final section of Obadiah's trip, you will perform a three-legged race to the steps of Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Contestants, are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, do you really think we can do this?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda, do you remember what you told Howard during practice the other day. You said this event is all about being in sync.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And I... I've been in sync with you from the moment we first met.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... I... I...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You don't have to say anything, Linda. Just run with me, and you'll see I'm right.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Contestants! On your marks...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Prepare to lose, losers!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Get set... Go!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Get ready to eat our moon dust!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Pretty simple, actually. I bribed the janitor.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, and he gave us a keycard that opens up the security corridor running beneath the mall.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, I almost forgot, he gave us something else... The `escalator control codes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I almost forgot, he gave us something else... The [color=#e23b3b][i]escalator control codes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Haha! Let's use it to `reverse` the escalator!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha! Let's use it to [color=#e23b3b][i]reverse[/i][/color] the escalator!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You... wouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, actually... I kinda would! Good luck swimming upstream in those extravagant heels, ladies.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Down below, the girls began to panic.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Tom's right! We'll never make it up a reversing escalator wearing these cute but insensible shoes! We'll have to take the stairs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the stairs are on the other side of the mall! We'll never catch up to Tom if we go that way!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: And do you have a better idea?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... We're cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So why don't we form a human pyramid to get to the second floor?

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: You can't be serious.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No! It'll work! I know it! Taylor, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I think we should...

nodes.text: In a parking lot to the side of the town square, sinister events were afoot...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Steph, where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Back off, Tom. We're done.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hardly! You agreed to help Spartan Academy win the Crosstown Races. We're not done until I'm holding that trophy.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Steph, ask yourself... Do you want that internship at Prince Research Labs or not?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Fine... What were you thinking?

nodes.text: And so, the two conspirators hatched a devious plot...

nodes.text: Okay, guys, the next major event is the 'Quiz Bowl'. In this event, our team will be asked a series of questions.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Just so you know... Wilson High already failed.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Spartan had that creepy nerd Preston on their side... And they aced it!

nodes.text: Are we in position, Angie?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Was that a 'yes' or...?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! We're obviously ready!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, but I still don't see what facial hair has to do with it.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Just forget it! Judge Tigh is here. That means this event is about to start!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Okay, kids. I'm going to test how well you were paying attention during the speech I gave this morning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But unfortunately, the next event will have to wait.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because, right at that very moment, trouble was brewing near the Centerscore High ready station.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Linda, is that you? We need to get down to the football field to prepare for the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... Why won't the lights turn on?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! You're not Linda! What're you doing in here?! What are you...?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew

nodes.speaker: Andrew

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, what happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was Steph... I think she was tampering with our equipment.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa... You weren't kidding! It looks like Steph snipped some of the stitches on the bindings you and Linda were going to use for the three-legged race.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What? Why would she do that?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So the bindings would `break` mid-race. Getting separated from your partner in a three-legged race is grounds for instant disqualification.
nodes.text_bbcode: So the bindings would [color=#e23b3b][i]break[/i][/color] mid-race. Getting separated from your partner in a three-legged race is grounds for instant disqualification.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then it's a good thing you stopped her, Howard. Otherwise, we would've lost everything. But now we can fix the bindings and be ready to compete!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Well, I wouldn't be too optimistic about our chances. When I fell over, I think I twisted my ankle.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Your ankle? But that means...!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know! I won't be able to race!

nodes.text: So you see, Steph may not have carried out her plan, but she did deliver Centerscore a mighty setback.

nodes.text: You see, historically, Spartan Academy has dominated the competition in every sporting event that they've ever entered... Except one.

nodes.text_bbcode: But Tom Prince could not abide the notion of losing an event celebrating his ancestor, [color=#e23b3b][i]Obadiah Prince...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, with the assistance of Steph, a renegade student from Wilson High... Tom framed Howard, Brendan, and Hector for arson.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: By doing so, he intended to fan the embers of enmity between Centerscore and Wilson into a white-hot conflagration...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But not everything went according to plan...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you two teamed up and found out the truth?! So what?! I've already won!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not yet, you haven't! The Crosstown Races are tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Centerscore is going to show up, and we're going to beat you and Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah! And you have to get past Wilson High as well, right Steph?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: That's right! It's payback time!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But will Centerscore High actually win? Or will Tom Prince and his fellow Spartans rule the day? Find out in...

nodes.text: So it was Tom Prince the whole time? That jerk!

nodes.text: You're telling me!

nodes.text: But what are we going to do about it?

nodes.text: But Tom Prince could not abide the notion of losing an event celebrating his ancestor, `Obadiah Prince...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But Tom Prince could not abide the notion of losing an event celebrating his ancestor, [color=#e23b3b][i]Obadiah Prince...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And so, with the assistance of Steph, a renegade student from Wilson High... Tom framed Howard, Brendan, and Hector for arson.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: By doing so, he intended to fan the embers of enmity between Centerscore and Wilson into a white-hot conflagration...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But not everything went according to plan...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you two teamed up and found out the truth?! So what?! I've already won!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not yet, you haven't! The Crosstown Races are tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Centerscore is going to show up, and we're going to beat you and Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah! And you have to get past Wilson High as well, right Steph?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: That's right! It's payback time!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But will Centerscore High actually win? Or will Tom Prince and his fellow Spartans rule the day? Find out in...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The next morning, the Centerscore High team assembled in the town square.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So it was Tom Prince the whole time? That jerk!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're telling me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But what are we going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're going to win, that's what!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This was all about the Crosstown Races from the very beginning. No way are we going to let Tom Prince take home that trophy.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Totally.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey guys, the opening ceremonies are about to start.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's just a stupid history lesson. Maybe we should skip it and go over the basics one more time instead.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, we could do that, but the opening ceremonies could also be important.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What do you think, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think...

options.label: We should go over the basics.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Wow! I sure am glad Howard had us sit through that speech.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Going into the final event, Spartan has a commanding lead, we're in `second...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Going into the final event, Spartan has a commanding lead, we're in [color=#3b78e2][i]second...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And Wilson High is totally out of the running.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Fortunately, the three-legged race is worth more than enough points to put Centerscore over the top.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoever wins this race is going to `win it all!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoever wins this race is going to [color=#3b78e2][i]win it all![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And the winners are... `Kenji and Linda`, representing Centerscore High!
nodes.text_bbcode: And the winners are... [color=#e23b3b][i]Kenji and Linda[/i][/color], representing Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Howard looked to the finish line. There he saw Kenji and Linda lifted onto the shoulders of an exuberant and victorious Centerscore High team.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes! Kenji, we did it!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Heh. Looks like the party started without you, hero.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whatever. My team won the Crosstown Races. It's not about who gets credit.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Sure, keep telling yourself that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kenji!!! Kenji!!!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kenji!!! Kenji!!!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kenji!!! Kenji!!!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In the days to come, the Centerscore High team would learn how Howard's actions contributed to the historic victory.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But not that day, and not right then. Yes, fate can be cruel...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But fate can also be `just.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But fate can also be [color=#e23b3b][i]just.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The victory that prompted Centerscore to celebrate also drove Tom Prince into an apoplectic fit of rage.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No!!! No!!!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh, Tom...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unacceptable!!!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Seriously, Tom...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You tell me! How many buildings do I have to torch before you idiots finally get your act together and win this?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Excuse me, son... What did you just say about 'torching buildings'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Because there was a library torched over at Wilson High not too long ago...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And the witness reported that the culprits were 'three teenage males' who seem to match the description of you three teenage males pretty closely.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But that's ridiculous, right? I'm sure you boys have rock solid alibis for the night of the fire, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes, of course, we... Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the Crosstown Races drew to a close, the contestants and spectators assembled outside the school to listen to Judge Tigh's closing remarks...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, today we have witnessed an extraordinary competition between three extraordinary groups of young men and women.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And though these events celebrate the great deeds of the past, they also celebrate the great deeds yet to come.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I commend you all! Good night, and congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: In fact, you were `perfect!` Enjoy this bonus scene. It takes place a few weeks after the race.
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, you were [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color] Enjoy this bonus scene. It takes place a few weeks after the race.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Reading is more than important, it's fundamental.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Knowing this, The `Prince Unlimited Corporation` could not stand idly by knowing that students in our community were forced by tragic circumstance to attend a school with no library.
nodes.text_bbcode: Knowing this, The [color=#e23b3b][i]Prince Unlimited Corporation[/i][/color] could not stand idly by knowing that students in our community were forced by tragic circumstance to attend a school with no library.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There were a few familiar faces in the audience...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Tragic circumstance'? Yeah, right. His kid burned down a building and then blamed the fire on us.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Technically, the plea bargain Tom signed admits no culpability.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you're saying, legally, the building burned `itself` down?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're saying, legally, the building burned [color=#e23b3b][i]itself[/i][/color] down?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Legally, yes... but Tom's not getting off scot free. One of my sources reported that Silas cracked open Tom's trust fund to cover the construction costs.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well, even so... I doubt Tom learned he can't cheat his way to victory.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Probably not. But watching him squirm while Officer Monte questioned him was pretty satisfying.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey! Mallika, what are you up to?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I just finished editing my documentary on The Crosstown Races. But now I'm wondering... Do you guys think Silas Prince seems unusually calm right now?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now that you mention it... He doesn't seem angry at all.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, it's almost like he's up to something... Like everything is going `according to plan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it's almost like he's up to something... Like everything is going [color=#3b78e2][i]according to plan.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if that's true, it'll have to wait. Hector'll be here any minute.
Moments later, Hector pulls up in his car.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bros, we're going back to my place for a celebratory pool party. You in?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector bought me floaties!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Sure, but I may need to borrow some sun block.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cool! Hop in! Spike, Phil, Taylor and the rest of the guys are going to meet us there!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: As the gang climbed into Hector's Party Van, Howard glanced across the Parking Lot and noticed Linda standing with Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Am I supposed to be impressed?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Definitely. This car may not look like much, but there's a ton of horsepower underneath this hood.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Fastest hunk of junk in the galaxy, huh?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, I'm heading over to Hector's for a Pool Party. Wanna come with?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, definitely! But what about...?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No worries. I

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We've got to celebrate our victory, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh, yeah! Good team work.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, that was the Bonus Scene.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And as you can see, nearly everybody got what they deserved...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And Linda and Howard? Well... Did you notice that Linda's eyes lingered on Kenji for a moment too long?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Could it be possible that the thrill of victory rekindled an old spark?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: There's only one way to find out! Be sure to return next time for fresh new adventures!
